declarations.name: restricted_pair_mem
declarations.source_header:
private theorem restricted_pair_mem {N : ℕ} (M : AlgebraData N) (G : M.GaugeData)
    (f : SmoothCore N) (hf : f ∈ G.invariantCore) :
    (coreToL2 f, M.chargeVector f) ∈ LinearMap.range
      ((coreToL2.comp G.invariantCore.subtype).prod
        (M.chargeVector.comp G.invariantCore.subtype))

declarations.name: restricted_range_to_closed
declarations.source_header:

    (hp : p ∈ LinearMap.range
      ((coreToL2.comp G.invariantCore.subtype).prod
        (M.chargeVector.comp G.invariantCore.subtype))) :
    p ∈ originalRestrictedClosedGraph M G

theorem original_restricted_graph_iff (v : FullL2 2) (y : SpinIndex → FullL2 2) :

declarations.name: other_cauchy
declarations.source_header:
private theorem other_cauchy (A : ι → D →ₗ[ℂ] F)
    (a b : ι) (h : ∀ d : D, ‖A b d‖ = ‖A a d‖) (f : ℕ → D)
    (ha : CauchySeq (fun n => A a (f n))) :
    CauchySeq (fun n => A b (f n))

declarations.name: component_graph_iff
declarations.source_header:
theorem component_graph_iff [CompleteSpace F] (J : D →ₗ[ℂ] E) (A : ι → D →ₗ[ℂ] F)
    (a : ι) (h : ∀ (d : D) (b : ι), ‖A b d‖ = ‖A a d‖)
    (u : E) (v : F) :
    (u, v) ∈ closure (Set.range (fun d : D => (J d, A a d))) ↔
      ∃ y : ι → F, (u, y) ∈ closure
        (Set.range (fun d : D => (J d, fun b : ι => A b d))) ∧ y a = v

declarations.source_header:
def originalIndividualClosedGraph {N : ℕ} (M : AlgebraData N) (G : M.GaugeData)
    (a : SpinIndex) : Set (FullL2 N × FullL2 N)

declarations.name: source_literal_component_graph_iff
declarations.source_header:
theorem source_literal_component_graph_iff {N : ℕ} (M : AlgebraData N) (G : M.GaugeData)
    (a : SpinIndex)
    (h : ∀ (f : G.invariantCore) (b : SpinIndex),
      ‖coreToL2 (M.charge b f.val)‖ = ‖coreToL2 (M.charge a f.val)‖)
    (u v : FullL2 N) :
    (u, v) ∈ originalIndividualClosedGraph M G a ↔
      ∃ y : SpinIndex → FullL2 N,
        (u, y) ∈ closure (Set.range (fun f : G.invariantCore =>
          (coreToL2 f.val, fun b : SpinIndex => coreToL2 (M.charge b f.val)))) ∧
        y a = v

declarations.name: source_component_graph_iff
declarations.source_header:
theorem source_component_graph_iff {N : ℕ} (M : AlgebraData N) (G : M.GaugeData)
    (a : SpinIndex)
    (h : ∀ (f : G.invariantCore) (b : SpinIndex),
      ‖coreToL2 (M.charge b f.val)‖ = ‖coreToL2 (M.charge a f.val)‖)
    (u v : FullL2 N) :
    (u, v) ∈ originalIndividualClosedGraph M G a ↔
      ∃ y : SpinIndex → FullL2 N, (u, y) ∈ originalMinimalClosedGraph M G ∧ y a = v

declarations.name: weak_pairing_closed
declarations.source_header:
theorem weak_pairing_closed {D E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    (J A : D → E) (u v : E)
    (h : ∀ f : D, inner ℂ (A f) u = inner ℂ (J f) v)
    (x y : E) (hp : (x, y) ∈ closure (Set.range (fun f => (J f, A f)))) :
    inner ℂ y u = inner ℂ x v

declarations.name: source_graph_pairing_iff_weak
declarations.source_header:
theorem source_graph_pairing_iff_weak {N : ℕ} (M : AlgebraData N)
    (G : M.GaugeData) (a : SpinIndex)
    (h : ∀ (f : G.invariantCore) (b : SpinIndex),
      ‖coreToL2 (M.charge b f.val)‖ = ‖coreToL2 (M.charge a f.val)‖)
    (hout : ∀ x y : FullL2 N, x ∈ G.physicalSpace →
      (x, y) ∈ originalIndividualClosedGraph M G a → y ∈ G.physicalSpace)
    (u v : G.physicalSpace) :
    (∀ x y : G.physicalSpace,
      (x, y) ∈ (individualPhysicalOperator M G a).graph →
      inner ℂ y u = inner ℂ x v) ↔
    (∀ f : G.invariantCore,
      inner ℂ (coreToL2 (M.charge a f.val)) (u : FullL2 N) =
        inner ℂ (coreToL2 f.val) (v : FullL2 N))

declarations.name: native_adjoint_graph_pairing

    (u, v) ∈ Q.adjoint.graph ↔
      ∀ x y : E, (x, y) ∈ Q.graph → inner ℂ y u = inner ℂ x v

theorem physical_pair_closure {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    (P : Submodule ℂ E) (A : Submodule ℂ (E × E))
    (h : ∀ p : E × E, p ∈ A → p.1 ∈ P ∧ p.2 ∈ P) :
    (A.comap (P.subtype.prodMap P.subtype)).topologicalClosure =
      A.topologicalClosure.comap (P.subtype.prodMap P.subtype)

    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]

    (hgraph : A.graph = P)
    (hpair : ∀ u v x y : E, (u, v) ∈ P → (x, y) ∈ P →
      inner ℂ v x = inner ℂ u y) :
    A.IsFormalAdjoint A

declarations.name: submodule_pairing_transport
declarations.source_header:
private theorem submodule_pairing_transport {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    (P : Submodule ℂ E) (u v x y : P)
    (f qf g qg : E)
    (hf : f = (u : E)) (hqf : qf = (v : E))
    (hg : g = (x : E)) (hqg : qg = (y : E))
    (hs : inner ℂ qf g = inner ℂ f qg) :
    inner ℂ v x = inner ℂ u y

declarations.name: abstractSymmetricPairing
declarations.source_header:
private theorem abstractSymmetricPairing {D E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    (J : D → E) (A B : D → D) (f g : D)
    (ha : inner ℂ (J (A f)) (J (A g)) = inner ℂ (J f) (J (A (A g))))
    (hb : inner ℂ (J (B f)) (J (B g)) = inner ℂ (J f) (J (B (B g))))
    (h : A (A g) = B (B g)) :
    inner ℂ (J (A f)) (J (A g)) = inner ℂ (J (B f)) (J (B g))

declarations.name: pairing_on_closure
declarations.source_header:
theorem pairing_on_closure {X F : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
    (S : Set X) (A B : X → F) (ha : Continuous A) (hb : Continuous B)
    (h : ∀ x y : X, x ∈ S → y ∈ S →
      inner ℂ (A x) (A y) = inner ℂ (B x) (B y))
    (x y : X) (hx : x ∈ closure S) (hy : y ∈ closure S) :
    inner ℂ (A x) (A y) = inner ℂ (B x) (B y)

declarations.name: joint_range_pairing
declarations.source_header:
theorem joint_range_pairing {D E F ι : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
    (J : D → E) (A : ι → D → F) (a b : ι)
    (h : ∀ f g : D, inner ℂ (A a f) (A a g) =
      inner ℂ (A b f) (A b g))
    (p q : E × (ι → F))
    (hp : p ∈ closure (Set.range (fun f : D => (J f, fun i => A i f))))
    (hq : q ∈ closure (Set.range (fun f : D => (J f, fun i => A i f)))) :
    inner ℂ (p.2 a) (q.2 a) = inner ℂ (p.2 b) (q.2 b)

declarations.name: normalized_constant_pairing
declarations.source_header:
theorem normalized_constant_pairing {F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
    (x y : PiLp 2 (fun _ : Fin 16 => F)) (a : Fin 16)
    (h : ∀ b : Fin 16, inner ℂ (x b) (y b) = inner ℂ (x a) (y a)) :
    inner ℂ (x a) (y a) = (1 / 16 : ℂ) * inner ℂ x y

declarations.name: source_normalized_form
declarations.source_header:
private theorem source_normalized_form {N : ℕ} (M : AlgebraData N)
    (G : M.GaugeData) (a : SpinIndex)
    (hn : ∀ (f : G.invariantCore) (b : SpinIndex),
      ‖coreToL2 (M.charge b f.val)‖ = ‖coreToL2 (M.charge a f.val)‖)
    (hp : ∀ (b c : SpinIndex) (p q : FullL2 N × (SpinIndex → FullL2 N)),
      p ∈ originalMinimalClosedGraph M G →
      q ∈ originalMinimalClosedGraph M G →
      inner ℂ (p.2 b) (q.2 b) = inner ℂ (p.2 c) (q.2 c))
    (u v : (originalMinimalPhysicalHilbertChargeColumn M G).domain)
    (w z : (individualPhysicalOperator M G a).domain)
    (hw : (w : G.physicalSpace) = (u : G.physicalSpace))
    (hz : (z : G.physicalSpace) = (v : G.physicalSpace)) :
    inner ℂ (individualPhysicalOperator M G a w)
      (individualPhysicalOperator M G a z) =
      (1 / 16 : ℂ) * inner ℂ
        (originalMinimalPhysicalHilbertChargeColumn M G u)
        (originalMinimalPhysicalHilbertChargeColumn M G v)

declarations.name: paired_normalized_form
declarations.source_header:
theorem paired_normalized_form (a : SpinIndex)
    (u v : (originalMinimalPhysicalHilbertChargeColumn pairedAlgebraData pairedGaugeData).domain) :
    inner ℂ (individualPhysicalOperator pairedAlgebraData pairedGaugeData a (pairedIndividualInput a u))
      (individualPhysicalOperator pairedAlgebraData pairedGaugeData a (pairedIndividualInput a v)) =
      (1 / 16 : ℂ) * inner ℂ
        (originalMinimalPhysicalHilbertChargeColumn pairedAlgebraData pairedGaugeData u)
        (originalMinimalPhysicalHilbertChargeColumn pairedAlgebraData pairedGaugeData v)

declarations.name: graph_iff_representative
declarations.source_header:
theorem graph_iff_representative (P : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (x w : E) :
    (x, w) ∈ P.graph ↔ ∃ h : x ∈ P.domain, w = P ⟨x, h⟩

declarations.name: common_form_test_iff
declarations.source_header:
theorem common_form_test_iff (A : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (T : E →ₗ.[ℂ] F)
    (hd : A.domain = T.domain)
    (e : T.domain → A.domain) (he : ∀ u, (e u : E) = (u : E))
    (hf : ∀ u v : T.domain, inner ℂ (A (e u)) (A (e v)) =
      (1 / 16 : ℂ) * inner ℂ (T u) (T v))
    (u : T.domain) (w : E) :
    (∀ v : A.domain, inner ℂ w (v : E) = inner ℂ (A (e u)) (A v)) ↔
    (∀ v : T.domain, inner ℂ w (v : E) =
      (1 / 16 : ℂ) * inner ℂ (T u) (T v))

declarations.name: naturalSquare_of_common_form
declarations.source_header:
theorem naturalSquare_of_common_form [CompleteSpace E]
    (A : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (T : E →ₗ.[ℂ] F) (H : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E)
    (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (hd : A.domain = T.domain)
    (e : T.domain → A.domain) (he : ∀ u, (e u : E) = (u : E))
    (hf : ∀ u v : T.domain, inner ℂ (A (e u)) (A (e v)) =
      (1 / 16 : ℂ) * inner ℂ (T u) (T v))
    (hHdom : H.domain ≤ T.domain)
    (hH : ∀ (u : T.domain) (w : E),
      (∀ v : T.domain, inner ℂ w (v : E) =
        (1 / 16 : ℂ) * inner ℂ (T u) (T v)) ↔
      ∃ h : (u : E) ∈ H.domain, w = H ⟨u, h⟩) :
    naturalComp A A = H
